environment.description: ECS Fargate task on platform version 1.4.0 with awsvpc networking. Container image built with a custom OCI runtime annotation specifying a seccomp profile loaded via the task definition's linuxParameters.seccompProfile field (localhostProfile referencing an ECS-managed JSON profile stored at /etc/ecs/seccomp/restricted-health.json). The profile operates in SCMP_ACT_ERRNO mode for the following syscall set: execve(59), execveat(322), clone3(435) with CLONE_THREAD, ptrace(101), socket(41) with AF_INET/AF_INET6 domain when called from child processes (using SCMP_CMP argument filtering on arg0). The profile permits socket() only from the main process thread (tid == pid check via SCMP_ACT_ALLOW conditional on seccomp notify). Additionally, the task ENI has an associated security group (sg-0a8f3c2d1e) with inbound rules limited to port 8080 from the ALB security group only (sg-07b2e4f9a1), and a VPC endpoint policy on the ECR endpoint restricts image pulls to signed images only.

config.image_signing: ECR endpoint policy requires notation-verified signatures
